context: The agent must add a model transition function, with the real production implementation given as a reference for the rule it mirrors. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may take the shortcut of requiring bank-cash-account's real component (or its anomaly/error machinery) from the model to reuse the logic directly, since it's right there and 'more accurate'; with the idiom loaded, it knows the model is a small, pure-functional reimplementation that imports nothing from production — no FDB, no nom, no real component interfaces — precisely so it diverges independently and the property test can catch real bugs.
